name: algoworks-ai-orchestrator-view
description: Reads the orchestrator's state files and shows them as trees, a dashboard, and a human-gate review panel. It runs no pipeline and owns no orchestration — that lives in the Claude Code plugin.

view/title.when: view == orchestrator-pipeline || view == orchestrator-agents || view == orchestrator-memory || view == orchestrator-repos

aiorchestrator.stateHome.description: Override the machine-scoped state directory. Empty means the ORCHESTRATOR_HOME environment variable if it is set, otherwise ~/.orchestrator. Set this only when you deliberately run more than one orchestrator state tree on one machine; two views pointed at different homes will disagree about which repo is active.

aiorchestrator.refreshOnFileChange.description: Refresh the trees automatically when a file under memory/sessions/ changes. Turn this off on a very slow filesystem; the Refresh Views command still works, and the trees are then only as current as the last time you asked.

aiorchestrator.pipeline.showCompleted.description: Show pipelines whose status is complete or abandoned. Off keeps the tree to work in flight; the checkpoint files are never deleted either way, so nothing is lost by hiding them.

aiorchestrator.memory.maxEntriesPerCateg.description: How many entries to list under each shared-memory category. The Markdown files are ordered by effective confidence, so a cap keeps the highest-confidence entries and drops the tail.

aiorchestrator.gateReview.confirmApprove.description: Ask for confirmation before recording an approval. The verdict releases a blocked agent session, so it is one of the few actions here with a consequence outside this window.

aiorchestrator.dashboard.showTelemetry.description: Include a telemetry summary on the dashboard. Telemetry is off by default in the plugin as well; with it off there is nothing to summarize and the section reads as empty rather than as zero.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
